text: The hybrid architecture is chosen -- Azure runs grain-ingest, AWS holds the DR backup. Before Dante writes one resource block, this video plans the Terraform module boundaries.
Three modules, three jobs: network owns the VNet, aks owns the cluster, sql owns Azure SQL. Each one only takes the inputs it actually needs from the others.
Remote state lives in fairmonttfstate, container tfstate, key platform.tfstate -- the exact backend named back when the architecture was chosen.
Azure Blob Storage locks that state file with a native lease. Two people running Terraform at once get one apply and one polite refusal, not a corrupted state file.
The module seams are set. Next: designing how grain-ingest actually runs on AKS -- the HPA scaling strategy and a zero-trust NetworkPolicy.
